say:0:1730510101:1.text: I was hoping to win some tokens and redeem some goods.
say:0:1730510101:1.source_cn: 我原本是打算多赚点青符，然后去看看能换些什么东西的。
say:0:1730510101:1.male: I was hoping to win some tokens and redeem some goods.
say:0:1730510101:1.female: I was hoping to win some tokens and redeem some goods.

say:1:1730510102:1.text: By the looks of things, I'm afraid you won't be getting anything fancy.
say:1:1730510102:1.source_cn: 不过按你手里的青符，可换不到什么好东西。
say:1:1730510102:1.male: By the looks of things, I'm afraid you won't be getting anything fancy.
say:1:1730510102:1.female: By the looks of things, I'm afraid you won't be getting anything fancy.

say:2:1730510103:1.text: If I were you, I'd get more tokens and keep trying my luck.
say:2:1730510103:1.source_cn: 要我说，你还是得再换些青符，然后牌桌上赚点。
say:2:1730510103:1.male: If I were you, I'd get more tokens and keep trying my luck.
say:2:1730510103:1.female: If I were you, I'd get more tokens and keep trying my luck.
